verdict.rationale: The evidence shows three.js ships its own production renderers (WebGL and WebGPU) and a node-based material system that includes MeshStandardNodeMaterial, the standard lit material, so the core renderer half of the story is documented. Nothing in the pack covers shadows, post-processing, or global illumination/baked lighting; one community commenter even asks whether three.js can generate lightmaps, with no answer given. missing for 10: explicit PBR material documentation, shadow mapping evidence, post-processing pipeline evidence, GI or baked-lightmap support, independent hands-on corroboration of rendering quality.
